emit

Fires a named hook when it exists — centralizes optional dispatch.

trackInstalling

Wires a registration's install lifecycle to the hooks — the semantics the retired package shipped: updatefound → watch installing → on installed, cached when no prior controller else updated.

(module scope)

Localhost probe — a dev server on the origin would serve the dev index for /service-worker.js; registering that would hijack dev. Verify the script exists and answers a JS mime before registering.

isLocalhost

True on local origins — localhost names, loopback IPs, and [::1]. The original package treated these as "probably dev" and probed before registering; preserved identically.

(module scope)

Registers swUrl and reports lifecycle through hooks. No-ops when navigator.serviceWorker is unavailable. Local hosts get the existence/mime probe first; a bad probe unregisters rather than installing a dev-shell SW.

dropStaleServiceWorkers

Unregisters every service worker bound to the current origin. No-op outside browsers and where getRegistrations is unavailable; failures are swallowed — this is best-effort cleanup, never a boot blocker.
